premises.text: Existing fitness trackers and logs fail to easily track strength exercises beyond steps
premises.evidence_span: there's just never been an easy way to do it

premises.text: A smartwatch app uses built-in motion sensors to automatically identify exercises, count reps, and estimate calories
premises.evidence_span: the first and only smartwatch app that automatically identifies your exercises, counts your repetitions, and tracks calories burned

premises.text: Users can train the app in seconds to recognize custom exercises including indoor cardio
premises.evidence_span: It takes only three seconds to train VemoFit to track any of my favorite exercises

premises.text: Patent-pending algorithms achieve accurate tracking from consumer-grade watch sensors alone
premises.evidence_span: our engineers were able to accomplish it using only the consumer-grade sensors of the Android Wear and Apple Watch

premises.text: Primary users are home and gym strength trainees underserved by runner/cyclist apps
premises.evidence_span: the first solution for the other 70% of the population that prefers to work out at home or in the gym

premises.text: GTM uses fitness influencers, personal-trainer O2O tools, and viral CrossFit/bodybuilding communities
premises.evidence_span: first leverage our strong relationships with popular fitness influencers to help us spread the word in the community

premises.text: Freemium model monetizes trainer routines, feedback, motivation, and personalized product offers
premises.evidence_span: VmoFit will operate on a freemium business model, allowing your favorite personal trainers to create professional routines, give you feedback on your workouts, and help you stay motivated to reach your goals

value.text: Frictionless automatic tracking of gym and home strength workouts
value.evidence_span: VemoFit takes the friction out of tracking my workouts
